question: Should the final rebased head be approved to replace all 13 executable GitHub Action pins across credential-bearing, release, scanning, and repository-automation workflows?
rationale: The patch has no concrete line-level defect, but repository policy reserves acceptance of new executable supply-chain revisions with secret and release access for a human owner.

options.title: Approve Final Exact Head
